name: Love?
source: You will be playing the life of a young adult trying to find value in life and the yearning for romance. You will face a number of romances but only one will ultimately become your true love and it's up to you who you pick. Will your choice be made on lust or passion, devotion or beauty? Will you find your love of find heartbreak? The choice is yours...
